Dangerous Goods

Kemasan perantara

A packaging component positioned between inner and outer packaging to provide additional protection, separation, or containment for dangerous goods.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Kemasan perantara?

In this glossary, Kemasan perantara refers to: A packaging component positioned between inner and outer packaging to provide additional protection, separation, or containment for dangerous goods.

How is Kemasan perantara used in logistics?

In logistics communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Kemasan perantara digunakan ketika wadah dalam membutuhkan pemisahan atau penahanan tambahan sebelum kemasan luar akhir."

Why does Kemasan perantara matter in logistics?

Kemasan perantara matters because it supports clear communication in Dangerous Goods contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Who uses Kemasan perantara?

Kemasan perantara is mainly used by Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers.

What category does Kemasan perantara belong to?

In this glossary, Kemasan perantara is grouped under Dangerous Goods. Related pages in this category explain adjacent procedures, commands and operational concepts.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from Incoterms 2020 (ICC), FIATA, IATA DGR, WCO and published by Protermify Logistics as a static logistics reference page.

Definition

A packaging component positioned between inner and outer packaging to provide additional protection, separation, or containment for dangerous goods.

Operational example

Intermediate packaging is used when inner receptacles require separation or additional containment before final outer packaging.

Localized term
